name: Kea DHCP
author: Netlens
description: Reads the DHCP leases (and the fixed reservations) of ISC Kea through its Control Agent: every lease with a MAC address becomes a client with its IP address and the host name the device gave. Netlens matches them to what it finds on the network by MAC address and uses the names. Read-only: it only runs the lease4-get-all and config-get commands.

info.title: What Kea needs
info.text: Kea must run the Control Agent (kea-ctrl-agent, port 8000 by default) and the DHCPv4 server needs the lease_cmds hook library (libdhcp_lease_cmds.so) in its hooks-libraries; without it Kea answers 'lease4-get-all command not supported'. Give the agent an 'authentication' block (type basic) and use that user here. Only DHCPv4 is read.

config.label: Kea servers
config.help: One line per Kea Control Agent.

columns.label: User
columns.help: Empty when the agent has no authentication (not advised).

config.label: Also read the reservations
config.help: Fixed addresses from the Kea configuration (hosts with a MAC address) are reported too, so a device that is off still gets its name.
